description: D.M. Corporation Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 28 May 1958 as a public limited company, and was formerly named D.M. Textile Mills Limited. It is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, and its stated principal line of business is real estate development — investment, development, marketing, construction, and the purchase, sale and lease of real estate assets and ancillary activities. Its registered office and mill are in the Westridge Industrial Area of Rawalpindi.
sourceNote: Written from: dmtextile.com.pk — Profile of the Company, Business Activity, Contact and profile-of-directors pages (accessed 2026-10-17)
